title: Plugin distribution classification
description: Schema for .github/plugin-distribution.yml in a plugin repo. classification.mjs enforces the same rules and is authoritative; anything that does not match reads as private. Editors can use this file for completion and inline errors.

classification.description: Only public is ever copied to a public catalog.

reviewed.description: ISO date of the last classification review.

catalog.description: Target public catalog: core = marketplace, labs = marketplace-labs-public.

include.description: Extra repo-relative paths to copy beyond the default allowlist. Never under .github/ or .git/, never absolute, never with . or .. segments.
